question: The Ahmadiyya forms a sect of Islam which originated from India. It was founded by ______ in 1889.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirza Ghulam Ahmad.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirza Ghulam Ahmad** founded the** Ahmadiyya sect of Islam** in **1889.**
 
• Mirza Ghulam Ahmad was born in** Qadian, India, in 1835,** and was a** religious leader and reformer** who claimed to be the promised Messiah and Mahdi.
 
• The **Ahmadiyya sect of Islam **is based on the belief in the prophethood of Mirza Ghulam Ahmad and his teachings, which include the concept of jihad as a** non-violent struggle for self-improvement** and the **promotion of peace and tolerance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mir Nisar Ali** was a religious scholar and poet who lived in the **18th century** and wrote several works on Islamic theology and mysticism.
 
• **Haji Shariatullah **was a** 19th-century Islamic reformer **who founded the Faraizi movement in Bengal.
 
• **Shah Walliullah **was an **18th-century Islamic scholar and reformer **who is credited with reviving the study of Islamic theology and law in India.
